name: Pi Agent — The Minimalist Coding Harness That Adapts to YOU | Alejandro AO
description: You define templates in ~/.pi/agent/prompts/ as Markdown files. Any template in that directory becomes a slash command. It’s like having a library of expert prompts on speed dial. Skills are self-contained capability packages.
